notes.title: Keybind Changes + Free Demo!
notes.content:
⚙️ Keybinds Changes

We’ve made an important change to how zoom keybinds work in Scope X.  
From now on, Increase Zoom, Decrease Zoom, and Set Zoom actions will only function when the Zoom Overlay is already active.  

This means:  
 Toggling the overlay on (via your overlay keybind or the UI) comes first.  
 Once active, Increase/Decrease Zoom lets you smoothly adjust zoom levels.  
 Set Zoom instantly jumps to your chosen zoom level while the overlay is active.  

This ensures clearer, more predictable behavior for zoom keybinds.

🆓 Try Scope X for Free

Scope X now has a Demo!  
You can try Scope X before purchasing the full version. Some features are restricted, but you’ll still get a feel for how zoom, and keybinds work with limited access.  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3920360/Scope_X/

🌿 Small Updates  
 "Launch on startup " will match your system preference.  
 Dropdown selections now adapt to your active profile’s theme.  
 Aligned colors for Set Zoom and Reset Zoom keybind actions.  
 Modernized sliders and settings inputs for a cleaner look.  
 Fixed zoom sliders showing excessive decimal places.  
 Improved tray icon quality for a sharper look.  
 Fixed a bug where "unknown key" would appear in the keybinds

Thank you for all the great suggestions we’ve received in our Discord — they help us shape Scope X into something better every update.  
If you’re new here, we’d love for you to join our Discord and share your ideas too!  

Join our Discord here

🦆

notes.title: Zoom Profiles: Custom Setups for different games
notes.content:
🌟 Profiles Have Arrived!

The wait is over — Profiles are now in Scope X!  
You can now assign your Zoom Settings, Keybinds, and Accessibility Settings to specific profiles, and even associate them with a process for quick swapping.

What's New:  
 Create and save multiple profiles with your own settings  
 Associate profiles with specific processes for quick activation  
 Auto Profile Detection toggle — Scope X can switch profiles automatically when you’re in a mapped process  
 New theming across the Customize page to clearly show your active profile

notes.title: Patch Notes (2025/07/30)
notes.content:
🪴 Patch Notes

 Added ESC as an emergency keybind — hold for 3 seconds to remove the Scope X overlay  
 Fixed an issue where Global Toggle was not working as expected  
 Fixed an issue where Quit Scope X didn’t fully close the app — ALT+F4 now stops the process too  
 Fixed issues with Zoom Setting Sliders not behaving properly  
 Fixed an issue where ESC keypresses weren't triggering keybinds  
 Fixed an issue where Right Mouse Button wasn’t recorded in keybind inputs  
 Added a small animation when right-clicking to clear a keybind in the table  
 Fixed an issue where Controller Support wasn’t initializing correctly  
 Updated UI component for the Color Mode and Language Selector dropdown  
 Added a System Tray Notification when Scope X launches in the background  
 Added UI elements and detection support for PS5 Controllers  
 Keybind popup and table now reflect the correct controller type (Xbox or PS5) based on what you're using


Thank you again for all your support!
If you run into any issues or have suggestions for improving Scope X, don’t hesitate to drop by our Discord — we’re active there and always listening to community feedback.

notes.title: New Keybinds Experience, Focus Shapes, and More!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,


Thank you all for the amazing support recently — it’s been incredibly encouraging and has helped us a ton as we continue growing Scope X. This update brings new customization options, better UI flow, and a bunch of quality-of-life improvements. 


Here’s what’s new:



⌨️ New Keybinds Experience
What's New:

 All keybinds are now managed in a single, easy-to-use table — add as many as you need for any action.
 Added custom zoom amounts for Increase / Decrease Zoom.
 Added Delay (ms) setting for Toggle Zoom (Hold).
 New Set Zoom action to jump to a specific zoom level.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555467/73cb085bdac9e0494fb1aadb695d7989a6be5d66.png"]



 📐Focus Shape + Outline
What's New:

 New Focus Shape Settings UI for easier customization.
 Added Focus Shape Variants:
  
   Circle
   Square
   Rectangle
   Custom — define your own width, height, and roundness
  
 Easy toggle for Focus Shape Background.
 Focus Shape Outline has also been added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555467/49bd858ff0410b3ed891a7adda8c8d5ae309ad89.png



🪴Quality of Life Improvements

 Improved the Position Picker experience and fixed preview not loading.
 Added more UI animations for smoother transitions.
 Fixed UI stutter when changing shortcut keys or languages.
 Sidebar and title bar now update properly when switching languages.
 Added Zoom Behavior dropdown: Fixed Position, Follow Cursor.
 Consolidated Focus Shape, Zoom Settings, and Follow Cursor into a single Zoom Settings tab.
 Reduced sidebar width to maximize space in smaller window sizes.

notes.title: New UI, Cursor follow, Ring position, and Color blindness mode!
notes.content:
Happy Friday!
Hi everyone, we hope everything is going well!



The entire team has been working tirelessly to bring you some exciting new features to Scope X!



Let's jump right into them!


New UI!
Scope X is so new that it will change it's looks and available features very quickly. We think this updated UI will lay a great foundation for the future.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555467/2a1f2e380dbf99d351a242a528304c672f59c604.png"]
Ring position!
Many of you have asked for the ability to change the position of the Ring position (great for games like Hunt) and we've made that possible. Down the line, we'll make it easy to have multiple positions like we do in Crosshair X.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555467/d8a896b7aed7eab70af44b4a2ebd6a151bae35cf.png"]
Cursor / Mouse Pointer position following!
For MOBA, RTS, RPG players this feature is a huge W! The zoom position and ring position will follow your cursor when enabled.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555467/3ede6f84727fdc4d7a7b3dbee8ff25c7a3640fa8.png"]
Color blindness modes!
If you are color blind, you can select from these three modes to help correct your vision!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555467/9e8418c2c8a60a0b780849fa89477a28bea40cb5.png"]
Scope X and Rust
On a less exciting note, our friends over at Facepunch Studios have decided to block Scope X from being used in Rust. You will not get banned but the Scope X and the application should not be able to run simultaneously now or in the near future.



Please voice your concerns to them here:

https://support.facepunchstudios.com/hc/en-us/requests/new


More updates coming soon!
We have more exciting updates to come next week!



Have a great weekend!

notes.title: Scope X & Rust
notes.content:
What does this mean?
In short, you won't be able to use Scope X in Rust.



We want to clarify that, to our knowledge, no one has been banned, and we do not anticipate any bans resulting from this change.



This is strictly a block of our application in specifically Rust, and NOT in any other games. Thank you for your understanding. 

If you disagree with Facepunch's decision, we encourage you to let them know here: https://support.facepunchstudios.com/hc/en-us



Please join our Discord for further updates. https://discord.gg/customcrosshair


-- Matt North

Support, Community & Marketing Manager
